taskGoal: 完成 ProjectFlow V3.7.5 跨模型强事实泛化闭环、产品宪法固化、双真实模型验收、工程门禁与 GitHub 合并准备，并明确模型耗时和用量只作诊断、不限制思考质量。
actualChanges: 统一模型质量优先策略：reasoning 能力任务首次请求即可使用用户配置的宽松 Provider 上限，显式支持的 Responses 与 Chat 连接、语义和恢复请求全部保持 high；耗时、请求量和用量不会触发降档、减少 Evidence 或跳过合格 Final Synthesis。
将生产与 Eval 的 Semantic Scout 固化为 v13，补强 Agent Result/PROCESS_EVIDENCE 维度所需的注册能力读取，同时保留 Ground Truth 隔离、已知 Evidence ID、严格 Capability 决策和失败降级契约。
保留 DeepSeek 首次正式失败，并通过仅约束最终结构的显式 JSON Mode Freeze 2 完成 GLM 与 DeepSeek 的冻结 Holdout 和产品持久化回读验收；安全汇总只记录哈希、聚合指标和案例状态。
完成产品宪法、Agent Context Contract、Provider、架构、API、CI、Hermes、Obsidian、覆盖矩阵、模型资格和验收报告的一致性更新；未写入凭据、原始模型输出、reasoning 或绝对路径。
创建 PR #11，并完成分支与 PR 两套 GitHub 质量门禁；后端、前端、Playwright、Hermes、Obsidian、敏感扫描和 PostgreSQL 16 Testcontainers 均通过。
将功能 PR 合并为 master 提交 2d54d91，并验证 master Run 30702083514 全绿；Foundation Gate 与受产品宪法约束的 V3.8 Entry 已有客观通过证据。

verification.build: Frontend TypeScript and production build passed; Start-ProjectFlow.bat rebuilt the current working tree, reached frontend/backend health, and stopped with ports released.
verification.tests: Backend/H2 453 tests passed with 2 credential-gated real Provider tests skipped; frontend contracts 50/50; Playwright 8/8; Hermes 7/7 with 13 tools; Obsidian 18/18; sensitive-content scan passed; final PR and functional master GitHub gates including PostgreSQL 16 Testcontainers passed.
verification.manualCheck: Verified five formal model artifact hashes, both freeze hashes, safe JSON parse, PR #11 merge commit, final master CI, no committed credential pattern, no Tag/Release, and disclosed the existing three high dependency findings without applying a destructive downgrade.

sedimentCandidates: Quality-first reasoning policy: model elapsed time and usage are diagnostics, while explicit reasoning profiles keep high effort and use a loose Provider ceiling from the first request.

Cross-model acceptance pattern: preserve the first formal failure, refreeze only an evidenced technical capability, keep semantic inputs and thresholds unchanged, and archive only safe normalized evidence.
